limitations: These contracts record public source inspection only; they do not prove ASEN runtime behavior or complete session-store parity.
The ID rule covers only empty and strings.TrimSpace-blank values; it does not enumerate Unicode, canonicalize IDs, or prove every caller.
The start SQL contract does not prove timestamp format, timezone, transaction defaults, retries, schema behavior, durability, synchronization, or actual SQLite execution.
Ownership rules are caller assertions, not authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, or security.
The local lease comment is informational source text, not proof of synchronization absence or runtime payload behavior.
Create contracts do not prove resume identity selection, terminal synchronization, HTTP, MCP, Pi callers, Cloud delivery, or runtime SQLite behavior.

Live-registration contracts exclude resume or continuation, isolation, ended-row legacy ownership claims at 3290–3333, postcommit terminal mapping at 3374+, EndSession, runtime SQLite, concurrency, durability, remote delivery, normalization internals, and HTTP, MCP, or Pi callers.
Project normalization is only observed as a delegated call and result check; its internal algorithm is not asserted here.
Queue-helper invocation and even an enrolled journal row do not prove durable synchronization or remote delivery.

The ended legacy-ownership claim excludes resume, continuation, isolation, EndSession, terminal synchronization, callers, normalization internals, queue enrollment, remote delivery, and actual SQLite commit, rollback, concurrency, or durability; a returned ended error does not imply that no side effects occurred.
All 18 memory families remain MISSING or PARTIAL; E3-01 remains incomplete and must complete before E3-02.

cases.summary: Create and start entry points share a helper that rejects empty or strings.TrimSpace-blank session IDs with ErrSessionIDRequired.
cases.contract: CreateSession delegates shared ownership to CreateSessionWithOwnershipMode, which calls validateSessionID. StartSession delegates shared ownership through StartSessionWithOwnershipMode to startSessionRegistration, whose first guard calls the same helper. isBlankSessionID uses strings.TrimSpace(id) == empty; validateSessionID returns ErrSessionIDRequired for blank and nil otherwise.
cases.negativeControls: No Unicode whitespace enumeration, ID canonicalization, uninspected caller behavior, authorization, persistence, storage, or runtime execution is claimed.

cases.summary: Session start uses one conflict update to fill only blank identity fields, renew the local lease, and refuse ended rows.
cases.contract: startSessionRegistration calls startSessionTx with id, project, directory, and mode. Its INSERT columns and arguments are ordered exactly; on conflict it fills only trimmed/null-coalesced blank project and ownership mode and trimmed blank directory, preserves populated identity, renews the excluded lease only while ended_at is null, propagates exec and RowsAffected errors, and maps zero affected rows to ErrSessionAlreadyEnded.
cases.negativeControls: Now() is only an argument delegation fact. No timestamp format, timezone, durability, transaction defaults, retries, schema, canonicalization, full ownership behavior, synchronization, enrollment, or actual SQLite execution is claimed.

cases.summary: Session create validates requested identity and ownership before its transaction mutates the row.
cases.contract: CreateSession selects shared mode. CreateSessionWithOwnershipMode validates ID and mode, delegates project normalization, requires its trimmed result, then reads existing ownership inside withTx. Blank or same ownership is accepted; requested project-owned mismatch returns SessionProjectConflictError, while a shared request against a different existing project follows the persisted shared, project-owned, or unclassified ownership rule before createSessionTx.
cases.negativeControls: Ownership is not authentication or tenant isolation. NormalizeProject internals, concurrent registration outcomes, resume identity selection, callers, and runtime database behavior are not claimed.

cases.summary: Session create inserts six ordered columns and fills only blank identity fields on ID conflict.
cases.contract: createSessionTx inserts id, project, ownership_mode, directory, started_at, and local_creation_project with the exact ordered arguments. On conflict it replaces project, ownership mode, or directory only when the persisted value is blank under the inspected trim rules; populated identity remains unchanged and execution errors propagate.
cases.negativeControls: Now() and NormalizeProject are delegated values only. No timestamp, normalization algorithm, SQLite execution, retry, schema, durability, or concurrency behavior is claimed.

cases.summary: Session create rereads the persisted row and conditionally enqueues its persisted payload in the same write transaction.
cases.contract: Within the create withTx callback, createSessionTx runs before an exact persisted-row reread and enqueueSyncMutationTx. The session upsert payload is built from those persisted values. Local session upserts with a blank directory return before journaling, and local writes for a nonblank unenrolled project return without a mutation row; enrolled writes proceed through journal insertion before commit.
cases.negativeControls: Helper invocation is not durable synchronization. Cloud delivery, terminal sync, live enrollment, remote acknowledgement, retries, runtime SQLite behavior, and HTTP, MCP, or Pi caller behavior remain unproved.

cases.summary: Ordinary live registration reads persisted ownership before start and rejects incompatible requested or persisted ownership with branch-specific errors.
cases.contract: StartSessionWithOwnershipMode delegates ordinary flags resume false, effective nil, and isolated false. In its transaction, sessionOwnershipTx precedes sessionRegistrationProjectError and startSessionTx. Blank or same ownership and a shared request against persisted shared ownership are allowed. A different owner with requested project-owned mode returns SessionProjectConflictError wrapping ErrSessionOwnershipMismatch; shared requests against different project-owned or unclassified persisted ownership return errors wrapping ErrSessionOwnershipMismatch or ErrProjectOwnershipAmbiguous respectively. Every conflict returns before startSessionTx.
cases.negativeControls: Resume, continuation, isolation, ended-row ownership claims, postcommit terminal mapping, callers, normalization internals, runtime concurrency, and runtime database behavior are not claimed.

cases.summary: Accepted ordinary live registration always starts the row, then only missing or blank live identity is reread and offered to the sync queue from the same transaction.
cases.contract: For an accepted ordinary live identity, identityRepaired starts as !found and, for a found live row, becomes true when project or mode is empty or strings.TrimSpace(directory) is empty. startSessionTx is called after ownership acceptance in every missing, repair, or populated path. A fully populated identity returns without enqueue. A repaired identity is reread after start and its persisted row supplies the session upsert payload to enqueueSyncMutationTx in the same withTx callback.
cases.negativeControls: Calling the enqueue helper is not durability or enrollment proof. Resume, continuation, isolation, ended-row legacy ownership claims, postcommit terminal mapping, EndSession, terminal synchronization, remote delivery, normalization internals, callers, and runtime SQLite or concurrency are excluded.

cases.summary: Ordinary project-owned registration may atomically claim a blank-owner ended legacy session before returning terminality.
cases.contract: Ordinary registration delegates resume false, effective nil, and isolated false. When ownership is found, the request is project-owned, the persisted owner is blank, and ended_at is nonnull, foreignRecordOwnerTx rejects a foreign child owner with SessionProjectConflictError. Otherwise a conditional UPDATE sets project and ownership_mode only for the ended blank-owner row, propagates execution and RowsAffected errors, and reports a lost claim unless exactly one row changed. The persisted row is then reread and offered as a session upsert in the same transaction callback before claimed becomes true. Only a successful withTx result maps claimed to ErrSessionAlreadyEnded, so that returned sentinel does not imply absence of side effects.
cases.negativeControls: Resume, continuation, isolation, EndSession, terminal synchronization, callers, normalization internals, queue enrollment, remote delivery, and actual SQLite commit, rollback, concurrency, or durability are not proved.
